dara (docs): Heads-up: updating the Rate & Quota doc to add a tiny JS + Go migration snippet and a brief note about burst credits. PR: https://rwd/pulls/5170. Need quick review on header names and field names used in examples.

kai (sdk): Quick note: Hosted exposes X-Quota-Org, private exposes X-Tenant-Quota. Recommend showing both and feature-detecting with /quota as primary. Also use snake_case fields in examples (tokens_left, requests_left, quota_left).

dara (docs): Draft JS snippet in PR (very short):

```js
client.quota.get().then(q => {
  console.log(q.tokens_left, q.requests_left);
  if (q.requests_left > 0) return client.generate({model: 'rw-medium', prompt: 'hello'});
});
```

kai (sdk): Looks good. Suggest adding a one-line fallback showing header checks: check X-Quota-Org || X-Tenant-Quota when /quota isn't available.

emily (product): For the burst credits blurb: multi-tenant -> per-org burst; dedicated -> shared pool with tenant tagging. Keep it illustrative and not contractual. Add a tiny sample table in docs.

ryan (analytics): Also add a troubleshooting callout: "If tokens > 0 but requests == 0, check background jobs (embeddings, ingestion). Tokens != requests." Saves support time.

link-bot: link-check: https://grafana.internal/consumption?panelId=99999 returned 403. Recommend adding a screenshot and noting internal access.

dara (docs): I'll attach a sanitized screenshot to the PR and add caption: "internal panel - screenshot for illustration; use permalink for private embeds". Please react with :white_check_mark: after reviewing code/text in the PR.
